_doc: In-App Event spec for ~/Neatly/scripts/asc/app_event.py. Times UTC. The in-app window (Models/BestOf2026.swift) is Dec 10 2026 00:00 CT to Jan 6 2027 00:00 CT = 06:00Z on both ends. US only (local North Houston app). Deep link opens the Best of 2026 board; needs 3.1.1 (build 205+).
